ambient_events: The roof sheets tick and shift as the sun moves off them.
Grit blows in under the door and lies where it lands.
A dog you never see barks twice, somewhere past the last building, and thinks better of it.
Somebody outside runs an engine up, holds it, and lets it drop back to idle.
description: Inside, it's one room and most of it's floor. A pit with a plank over it, a bench down one wall under a rack of things that were taken off something and never went back on, and a paraffin heater nobody lights. The freight board is a sheet of ply with nails in it. Prices are chalked on the ply itself, rubbed out and rewritten so many times the board is grey.
name: The Last Load — the shed
